name: mulqi-context-compression
description: Model-driven, incremental, hierarchical context compression for DeepSeek Harness: bounded context windows, restorable digest blocks, long-lived sessions. One bundled doctrine skill plus four native tools (status, compress, decompress, search), an optional cross-session mycelium store that shares digest blocks between sessions of one user, and an opt-in auto fold engine that plugs the fold into the host's automatic compaction (no model trigger).
